faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers about website development and working together

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: A landing page starts from €299, a business website from €599, and a more complex web application from €1,499. The final price depends on features, design complexity, and timeline.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: A simple landing page takes 3-5 business days, a business website takes 7-10 days, and a web application takes 14-21 business days. The timeline depends on project scope.
I build modern websites using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. For backend I use Supabase, and for payments I use Stripe. This ensures speed, security, and SEO performance.
Yes, every website I build is fully responsive and adapts to phones, tablets, and desktop screens. This is essential for both SEO and user experience.

items.q: Will the website be optimized for Google search?
items.a: Yes, every project includes SEO fundamentals: speed, meta tags, semantic HTML, structured data, and a mobile version. I can also perform a comprehensive SEO audit if needed.

items.q: Where are you based and who do you work with?
items.a: I am based in Brussels, Belgium, and work with clients from Lithuania, Belgium, and worldwide. All communication happens via email, video calls, and project management tools.

items.q: Do I need my own domain and hosting?
items.a: No. I can help register a domain and choose hosting that fits your needs. I usually recommend Vercel or similar solutions for fast and secure performance.

items.q: What does the website development process look like?
items.a: We start with a short call to understand your goals. Then I prepare a proposal, design the site, get your approval, develop it and launch it. I keep close communication throughout the process.

items.q: Can I update the website content after launch?
items.a: Yes. Business website and web application packages include an admin panel where you can edit content yourself. I also offer additional technical support when needed.
Each stage includes up to 3 free revisions. This lets us align the design and functionality so the final result fully matches your expectations.
